name: F8_minimum_of_vectors_of_a_refreshing_group_read_on
description: Task 12.1, F8. The rolling minimum of the vectors of a refreshing group_by result, read by a later operation. The step takes a row out of the group, so C2 and U9 go from [-4, 8] to [8] on both servers, and the count of rows with len(U9) > 1 must go from 1 to 0. Java's o11 keeps 1: the minimum it holds is a view of the group, which is the same object before and after, so what reads U9 is not told of a change. Made again from the same rows Java's o11 is 0, as Oxhaven's is.
